milestone.title: herdr-log retirement — recover R1-R15 + session lessons into mp decisions and delete the repo-root logs

intent.outcome: The autopilot design requirements (R1-R15) and the hard-won orchestration lessons from the herdr test sessions live in the plan's decision log (`mp decision list`), and the fragile repo-root log files are gone.

problem.description: mp-herdr-log.txt and mp-herdr-log2.txt at the repo root were the only record of the autopilot design input. Commit 438b093 trimmed them to ~3-4k each and both now claim the content was 'migrated via M239' — which never happened. The full originals survive only in git history: `git show 438b093^:mp-herdr-log.txt` (1394 lines; R1-R15 at lines ~199-340, consolidated lessons ~463-535, open decisions on commit strategy ~539-668 and document structure ~670+) and `git show 438b093^:mp-herdr-log2.txt` (1466 lines; orchestrator-idle discipline, commit-on-handoff + 4-round cap, channel sanity test). master-plan/decisions.json (`mp decision add|list|remove`, currently D-1..D-19) is the existing durable store; no new CLI or schema is needed.

in_scope: Add 15 decisions via `mp decision add --milestone 239`, one per original requirement, summary prefixed `herdr-log R<n>: <heading>` (R1 Topology parameter … R15 Log file fragility). Context: a faithful condensation of the section (requirements, not narrative) ending with its source pointer, e.g. `source: git show 438b093^:mp-herdr-log.txt (lines 203-209)`.

Add at least 5 lesson decisions via `mp decision add --milestone 239`, summary prefixed `herdr-log L<n>: …`, covering: lane notifications must be shell commands; per-AC evidence discipline; orchestrator verifies state independently; orchestrator stays idle (no polling); commit-on-handoff + 4-round cycle cap; plus the two open decisions (git commit strategy, milestone document structure) with their status as recorded in the log. Same source-pointer convention.
Fix remaining references outside master-plan/ (mp-dogfood-log.md entries keep their historical text but gain a one-line pointer to `mp decision list`).
out_of_scope: A new `mp autopilot design-input` command, a per-topic JSON schema, or a master-plan/decisions/autopilot/ directory.
Gitignoring mp-herdr-log*.txt (future session logs should stay visible, not hidden).
Re-litigating the recorded open decisions — they are captured as-recorded.
Rewriting historical milestone JSON that mentions the logs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Both repo-root herdr logs are deleted and untracked.
acceptance_criteria.verification: test ! -e mp-herdr-log.txt && test ! -e mp-herdr-log2.txt && ! git ls-files -- 'mp-herdr-log*' | rg -q .

acceptance_criteria.description: mp decision list contains exactly 15 distinct 'herdr-log R<n>:' decisions (R1..R15), each citing its git source.
acceptance_criteria.verification: mp decision list | rg -o 'herdr-log R[0-9]+:' | sort -u | wc -l | rg -q '^\s*15$' && test "$(mp decision list | rg -c 'herdr-log R[0-9]+:')" -le "$(mp decision list | rg -c '438b093')"

acceptance_criteria.description: mp decision list contains at least 5 distinct 'herdr-log L<n>:' lesson decisions from both logs.
acceptance_criteria.verification: mp decision list | rg -o 'herdr-log L[0-9]+:' | sort -u | wc -l | awk '$1>=5{ok=1} END{exit !ok}'

acceptance_criteria.description: No file outside master-plan/ references the logs except the historical dogfood-log entries, and the plan validates.

work_packages.name: Log removal + references
work_packages.goal: Both repo-root logs deleted; references point at mp decision list

work_packages.name: Decision recovery
work_packages.goal: R1-R15 and >=5 session lessons recorded as mp decisions with git source pointers
work_packages.rollback: mp decision remove the herdr-log R*/L* entries

steps.action: Read git show 438b093^:mp-herdr-log.txt lines ~199-340 and add 15 decisions via mp decision add --milestone 239 --summary 'herdr-log R<n>: <heading>' --context '<condensed requirement>. source: git show 438b093^:mp-herdr-log.txt (lines a-b)'; mp validate.
steps.tests: mp decision list | rg -o 'herdr-log R[0-9]+:' | sort -u | wc -l | rg -q '^\s*15$' && mp validate

steps.action: Read the consolidated-lessons and open-decision sections of 438b093^:mp-herdr-log.txt and the session lessons of 438b093^:mp-herdr-log2.txt; add >=5 decisions via mp decision add --milestone 239 --summary 'herdr-log L<n>: …' with source pointers; mp validate.
steps.tests: mp decision list | rg -o 'herdr-log L[0-9]+:' | sort -u | wc -l | awk '$1>=5{ok=1} END{exit !ok}' && mp validate

steps.action: git rm mp-herdr-log.txt mp-herdr-log2.txt (no gitignore entry).
steps.tests: test ! -e mp-herdr-log.txt && test ! -e mp-herdr-log2.txt && ! git ls-files | rg -q 'mp-herdr-log'

steps.action: Add a one-line 'recovered into mp decision list (herdr-log R*/L*)' pointer to the mp-dogfood-log.md entries that cite the logs; confirm no other file outside master-plan/ references them; mp validate.
